cover_line: A short look at partykungen.se and where we would start.

paragraphs: Around 580,000 visits a month, about a third of them paid.
People spend two minutes and look at three pages per visit, which means most of them arrive knowing what they want and go looking for it. What happens after that, we can only see from the inside.

ideas.head: Shop by theme
lines: Most visitors come for an occasion, not a product. Right now they have to find the costume, the decoration and the tableware separately.
We would test theme pages that put everything for one occasion on one page and measure revenue per visitor.

ideas.head: Landing pages for paid traffic
lines: A third of the traffic is paid and most of it lands on generic category pages.
We would test landing pages that match the search people came from and measure the conversion rate of paid sessions.
